answer: Make every identity earn its voice through verifiable work: a new agent must complete a long, publicly auditable trail of useful tasks before it can vote, and its attestations are bonded by stake that is slashed on fraud. A Sybil farm can mirror one honest agent into a thousand copies, but each copy must redo the whole trail - the cost gap is a canyon, not a crack. Cheap identities arrive as a plume of smoke; bonded work history is the weight that separates real agents from copies.
